image.crop.label: Crop
image.crop.params: {"x":px,"y":px,"width":px,"height":px,"angle":-3600..3600=0,"deleteCroppedPixels":bool=true,"targetWidth":px,"targetHeight":px,"resolution":ppi,"resample":"bicubic|bilinear|nearest|lanczos|preserveDetails"="bicubic"} → {x,y,width,height,documentWidth,documentHeight,resolution} (targetWidth/targetHeight, both or neither: the cropped area is resampled to exactly that size, as Image Size, in the same undo step; resolution: the document's new ppi)

image.imageSize.label: Image Size…
image.imageSize.params: {"width":px,"height":px,"percent":%? (both sides; an explicit side wins),"resolution":ppi,"keepPrintSize":bool=false (with only a resolution: resample the pixels to keep the print size),"resample":"automatic|preserveDetails|bicubicSmoother|bicubicSharper|bicubicAutomatic|bicubic|nearest|bilinear|lanczos|none"="bicubic"} → {width,height} (the document's size after the command; "none" changes the resolution only)

layer.duplicate.label: Duplicate Layer…
layer.duplicate.params: {"layer":id?,"inPlace":bool=false (artboards: keep the copy on the original instead of beside it),"name":str? (one layer: the copy's name),"document":index|"new"=same document (Photoshop's Destination: "new" makes a new document the size of this canvas holding just the copies),"documentName":str? (the new document's name)} (no layer: every selected layer)

layer.newAdjustmentLayer.blackWhite.label: Black & White…
layer.newAdjustmentLayer.blackWhite.params: {"reds":-200..300=40,"yellows":-200..300=60,"greens":-200..300=40,"cyans":-200..300=60,"blues":-200..300=20,"magentas":-200..300=80,"tint":bool=false,"tintColor":"#rrggbb"} + {"path":"work"|saved path name|{…path}? (the active path: becomes the vector mask; else the selection is the layer mask, or white with no selection)}

layer.newAdjustmentLayer.colorBalance.label: Color Balance…
layer.newAdjustmentLayer.colorBalance.params: {"shadows":json,"midtones":json,"highlights":json,"preserveLuminosity":bool=true} (each tone [cyan-red, magenta-green, yellow-blue] in -100..100) + {"path":"work"|saved path name|{…path}? (the active path: becomes the vector mask; else the selection is the layer mask, or white with no selection)}

layer.newAdjustmentLayer.curves.label: Curves…
layer.newAdjustmentLayer.curves.params: {"points":json,"red":json,"green":json,"blue":json,"pencil":bool=false,"smooth":0..10=0,"eyedropper":json} (curves as [[in,out],…] in 0..255, 2..19 points: points = composite; red/green/blue, gray, cyan/magenta/yellow/black or lightness/a/b per channel; pencil = drawn curves (Draw to modify the curve): each curve is 256 output levels in 0..255 (point curves given are drawn in, and turning pencil off fits points to the drawing); smooth = Smooth passes over the drawn curves; eyedropper = the dialog's Set Black/Neutral Gray/White Point picker {"point":"black|gray|white","at":[x,y],"size":1..101=1} or {"point",…,"color":[r,g,b] 0..1}, RGB and Grayscale (no gray) only, applied over the given curves) + {"path":"work"|saved path name|{…path}? (the active path: becomes the vector mask; else the selection is the layer mask, or white with no selection)}

layer.newAdjustmentLayer.gradientMap.label: Gradient Map…
layer.newAdjustmentLayer.gradientMap.params: {"stops":json,"reverse":bool=false,"dither":bool=false} (stops [[location 0..1, "#rrggbb"], …], 2..64) + {"path":"work"|saved path name|{…path}? (the active path: becomes the vector mask; else the selection is the layer mask, or white with no selection)}

layer.newAdjustmentLayer.levels.label: Levels…
layer.newAdjustmentLayer.levels.params: {"inBlack":0..253=0,"gamma":0.01..9.99=1,"inWhite":2..255=255,"outBlack":0..255=0,"outWhite":0..255=255,"red":json,"green":json,"blue":json,"eyedropper":json} (top level = composite; per channel {"inBlack","gamma","inWhite","outBlack","outWhite"} under red/green/blue, gray, cyan/magenta/yellow/black or lightness/a/b; eyedropper = the dialog's Set Black/Neutral Gray/White Point picker {"point":"black|gray|white","at":[x,y],"size":1..101=1} or {"point",…,"color":[r,g,b] 0..1}: black/white set each channel's input black/white to the sample, gray each channel's gamma so the sample turns neutral at its luma; RGB and Grayscale (no gray) only, applied over the given levels) + {"path":"work"|saved path name|{…path}? (the active path: becomes the vector mask; else the selection is the layer mask, or white with no selection)}

layer.newAdjustmentLayer.vibrance.label: Vibrance…
layer.newAdjustmentLayer.vibrance.params: {"vibrance":-100..100=0,"saturation":-100..100=0} + {"path":"work"|saved path name|{…path}? (the active path: becomes the vector mask; else the selection is the layer mask, or white with no selection)}

layer.removeBackground.label: Remove Background
layer.removeBackground.params: {"layer":id?,"sampleAllLayers":bool=false,"refine":bool=true} → {layer,bounds} (adds a layer mask from Select Subject; the Background becomes a normal layer)

layer.newAdjustmentLayer.hueSaturation.label: Hue/Saturation…
layer.newAdjustmentLayer.hueSaturation.params: {"hue":-180..180=0,"saturation":-100..100=0,"lightness":-100..100=0,"colorize":bool=false,"reds":json,"yellows":json,"greens":json,"cyans":json,"blues":json,"magentas":json} (per range {"hue","saturation","lightness","range":[4 hue degrees]}; colorize: hue 0..360, saturation 0..100) + {"path":"work"|saved path name|{…path}? paint.gradient.params: {"from":[x,y],"to":[x,y],"style":"linear|radial|angle|reflected|diamond"="linear","colors":["#rrggbb",…]?
